main.description: One label from a private labeler, with the fields of com.atproto.label.defs#label. Append-only: each apply or negation is a new record. The current state for a (src, uri, cid, val) is the latest record by cts, then by record key. Deleting a record is a purge: it counts as never written.

ver.description: The AT Protocol version of the label object. 1.

src.description: The labeler: always the space authority.

uri.description: What's labelled: the AT URI of a public record or account, an account DID, or the URI of a hidden post (a tools.umbrae.post in a tools.umbrae.space space). Nothing else from inside a space. A label on a hidden post is shown only to viewers who may see that post.

cid.description: Optionally, the version of the record this label applies to.

neg.description: If true, this negates an earlier label with the same src, uri, cid and val.

audience.description: The record key of a tools.umbrae.labelerAudience: the label is shown only to its members (and, on a hidden post, only to those who may also see the post). Unknown means shown to nobody. Covered by sig when set.

sig.description: The standard label signature, by the labeler's label key (labelKey in tools.umbrae.labelerPolicies): over the DRISL encoding of the label without sig (and without $type), with ver defaulting to 1, neg omitted unless true, and audience included only when set.
